en.title: Taiwan CAA to ban e-cigarettes and similar products on board aircraft from December 1
en.summary: Taiwan's CAA will ban heated tobacco products on board aircraft throughout the flight from December 1, with e-cigarettes remaining banned; violators face up to five years in prison or a NT$150,000 fine.
body: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) has announced that heated tobacco products will be banned on board aircraft throughout the flight from December 1, while e-cigarettes remain banned for the entire flight. The move aligns with the Tobacco Hazards Prevention Act and reflects concerns that emerging tobacco and similar products could endanger flight safety.

The CAA said using such products can produce a source of fire and smoke and may raise aircraft maintenance costs, threatening flight safety and emergency evacuation. Violators face up to five years' imprisonment, detention, or a fine of up to NT$150,000 under Article 102 of the Civil Aviation Act; causing a death carries life imprisonment or at least seven years, and causing serious injury carries three to ten years.

Passengers should check the rules on their airline's website or at the check-in counter before flying, the CAA said, and keep e-cigarettes, heated tobacco products and related items switched off for the entire flight to help keep the cabin safe and comfortable.

facts.claim: From December 1, heated tobacco products are banned on board aircraft throughout the flight, and e-cigarettes remain banned throughout the flight.

The ban follows the Tobacco Hazards Prevention Act and concerns that emerging tobacco and similar products could harm flight safety, including fire sources, smoke and higher aircraft maintenance costs.

Violators face up to five years' imprisonment, detention or a fine of up to NT$150,000 under Article 102 of the Civil Aviation Act; causing death carries life imprisonment or at least seven years, and causing serious injury three to ten years.
Passengers should confirm the rules on airline websites or at check-in counters before flying and keep related items switched off for the whole flight.

zh.title: 民航局：12月1日起機上禁用電子菸品或類菸品
zh.summary: 民航局宣布，自12月1日起，加熱菸於航空器上全程禁止使用，電子煙維持全程禁用的規定；違規者依民用航空法最高可處5年以下有期徒刑或新臺幣15萬元以下罰金。
body: 交通部民用航空局宣布，為符合菸害防制法規定，並考量電子煙、加熱菸等新興菸品及類菸品對飛航安全可能造成的危害，自12月1日起，加熱菸於航空器上全程禁止使用；電子煙則維持全程禁止使用的規定。
民航局指出，使用這類產品可能產生火源與煙霧，並可能增加航空器維修成本，威脅航空器飛航及緊急逃生安全。違規者依民用航空法第102條規定，處5年以下有期徒刑、拘役或新臺幣15萬元以下罰金；因而致人於死者，處無期徒刑或7年以上有期徒刑；致重傷者，處3年以上10年以下有期徒刑。
民航局提醒，民眾搭機前可至航空公司網站或於報到櫃檯確認相關規定；搭機後，應將電子煙、加熱菸等相關用品保持關閉狀態，並於飛航全程不得使用，以共同維護安全、舒適的飛行環境。
